name: bondsimulation2

name: objectsimulation

evidence: String 'data/building/%s.sbb' + fopen + memset. In the ELF only building_load calls memset.

name: building_save
evidence: String 'data/building/%s.sbb' + fopen, without memset. Pair of building_load.

name: createitem
evidence: Manager (native_sdk/black_market.c) calls it with (type, pos, vel, rot).

name: createbond
evidence: Checks numofbonds < 0x3fff and writes particle_a/particle_b at bond+0x14/+0x18 (matcher said createparticle).

name: playerai
evidence: Calls ai_assessthreats, ai_playercar, rand and atan2, like the playerai of the 0.24c ELF. Called by dedicatedserverloop. The Mac 0.25 suggested playersimulation (wrong: playersimulation calls nothing).

name: createevent_updatedoor
evidence: Event type 10 with 2 parameters, same as 0.24c. Rewritten in src/server/events.c.

name: createevent_updatemission
evidence: Event type 12 with mission data (game+0xd0, stride 0x117c per team and 0x40 per mission), same formula as 0.24c.

name: fixplayername

name: logic_gunstore_buy
